setupHistory.reason: Fixture expected no reset; existing Lifecycle performs one initial and three settings-transition resets. Independent no-op visibility control confirms existing policy.
exactOptionalPropertyTypes rejects an explicit undefined setter; installed descriptor now conditionally retains an existing setter.
Temporary Git config writes denied; host rerun passed.
Strict eval module binding unavailable; no product assertion executed; iframe removed before corrected run. Call execution vs approval wait unmeasured.
Formatting of added cleanup assertions; corrected via apply_patch and new clean copy passed.
